title: Leer's first implant removal: T-shaped object in uncuttable tissue
summary: Roger Leer tells of Leer's first implant removal: T-shaped object in uncuttable tissue, about 1990s at Thousand Oaks, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We found the object uh the first one and we took it out. Uh it looked like nothing that I had ever removed before in a way of a foreign body.

plain: Roger Leer, a doctor who says he studies alien implants in human bodies, tells of his first removal of one in the 1990s in Thousand Oaks, California. He says he took out a T-shaped object from tissue that was oddly hard to cut, and it looked like no foreign body he had ever removed before. If true, it would suggest something had been placed inside a person by non-human beings.
